Tonight, we are going to present to you a very interesting story of a Violin teacher named Pandit Satish Chandra. Kaushal is an aspiring music student who wants to learn to play violin. He approaches Pandit Satish and persuades to accept him as his student! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!
